claim_ceiling: No benchmark performance or physical transfer claim until source data, split, model and evaluator identities are pinned and exact runs are reproduced.

split_protocols.purpose: Reproduce the official benchmark interface, score and split exactly when the downloadable protocol and payload are recovered.
Keep every sample and overlapping window from a recording in one split.
Test transfer to a driving cycle absent from model fitting and conformal calibration.
Sensitivity analysis of scarce per-fault recordings; report all fold outcomes, do not inflate them to independent engine trials.
Assess cross-engine, cross-bench or vessel transfer.

comparators.role: Published structural/model-based reference; exact implementation and configuration must be recovered.
Physical-response channels only; no requested command channels.
Requested commands and operating context only; tests whether the control signal alone leaks the fault label.
Concatenate requested commands and physical response features with a matched classifier/capacity.
Predict physical response conditional on command, disturbance context and regime; score calibrated residuals.
Separate operating regime before response comparison; use bounded selective inference for unsupported regimes.
Known-fault isolation with an explicit unknown/abstain decision and risk-coverage reporting.

Calibrated physical engine model that evaluates multiple fault/degradation parameter hypotheses against the measured response. Preserve every admissible solution and report ambiguity rather than selecting a single minimum without identifiability evidence.
CAREngine: healthy-only neural/linear residual models, segmented adaptive ±2σ bounds, EWMA diagnostic features, QDA detection, Nystroem+LSVC isolation.
Four RLS local engine models; time-varying coefficient residual signatures; MSO/fault-sensitivity analysis; open-set residual-insensitive-region detectors.
Sliding-window Gaussian distribution descriptors with KL-divergence matching and thresholds for known/unknown residual patterns.
Healthy-system model, residual thresholds, cumulative alarm-density confirmation, four dedicated ANFIS isolation models.
Canonical-correlation-guided deep network with two views and redundancy filtering for correlated multivariate features.
Separate VAE/MLP detectors for fault detection and known-fault isolation plus a one-class SVM unknown-fault signal.

comparators.method: Set-valued intersection of calibrated, regime-specific multivariate behavioral envelopes with observation-uncertainty intervals; return all admissible hypotheses and preserve ambiguity.
comparators.claim_ceiling: singleton only within frozen catalogue; never global unique physical cause

comparators.role: Current DX2026 LiU-ICE public hidden-test reference: physically informed recurrent hidden states, four MSO/virtual-sensor residuals, fixed diagnosis matrix, adaptive covariate-shift compensation, and explicit debounce/warm-up. Faithful reproduction required before matched comparison.
Fixed-channel simple-null/simple-alternative likelihood-ratio e-process, with optional stopping and family-wise Bonferroni allocation.

primary_metrics.definition: Mean probability assigned to the true fault slot among correctly detected fault samples; not top-1 accuracy.

calibration.unit: one maximum residual score per independent recording/episode
calibration.when_insufficient: mark the affected regime not_evaluated; do not borrow samples across regimes after inspecting test outcomes

research_targets_not_achieved.target: At least +0.05 absolute official score versus the best faithfully reproduced baseline on the same frozen split, with FAR no worse.
At least +5 percentage points event recall over the best matched baseline at the same false-alarm budget.
At most 5% false-known rate on independent unknown-fault episodes; abstention and insufficient evidence reported separately.
No more than 2 percentage points loss in macro fault recall on each supported held-out driving cycle, relative to matched in-cycle performance.
Nominal marginal coverage within ±5 percentage points on independent episodes, only for regimes with sufficient calibration support.
Zero unique root-cause claims when two or more fault/parameter hypotheses remain inside the preregistered calibrated acceptance region.
At least +5 percentage points event recall versus the best matched baseline without increasing false alarms per observed normal hour, with recording-clustered uncertainty.
P95 event confirmation latency at or below 5 seconds on supported held-out episodes, or at least 20% lower than the best matched baseline at a non-increased false-alarm rate.
Zero missing/duplicate outputs, zero index gaps, and zero historical output mutations across all benchmark replay samples.
P95 per-sample inference plus receipt latency below 10 ms on declared reference hardware at 20 Hz, with bounded memory and no queue growth.

Selected evidence has positive worst-case expected information gain across every frozen calibrated likelihood scenario and reduces realized cost-to-identification versus cheapest-only and seeded-random matched baselines.
Exact golden-vector parity between Rust core and compliant Python or MATLAB adapter.
Improve worst-held-out-load event recall by at least 5 percentage points at no higher false-alarm exposure than the best matched baseline, with file-level uncertainty.
Demonstrate positive or quantify negative transfer between LiU-ICE and Marine Engine Fault using reviewed component/function mappings, separate label spaces and independent split manifests.
Independent evidence for all nine deployability dimensions with no dimension inferred from another.
Published p95/p99 latency, memory, throughput, receipt overhead and energy per sample on a pinned edge reference device.
All externally qualified results replay from exact data/model/evaluator/manifest digests and an independently reviewed evidence bundle.
Empirical envelope coverage within ±5 percentage points of declared marginal target on independent held-out recordings.
Zero forced top-one diagnosis when multiple hypotheses remain admissible.
At least 95% detection of independent out-of-support episodes at no more than 1% false unknown alarms on supported normal episodes.
At least +5 percentage points event recall versus a matched selective classifier without increasing false alarms per observed normal hour, while preserving ambiguity.

On the matched DX2026 protocol, exceed the published 88.01% official score by at least 2.00 absolute percentage points while keeping FAR at or below 7.86%, and report all 12 per-condition cells with no hidden aggregate masking.
Achieve p95 event confirmation latency at or below 0.50 seconds on supported onset-annotated cases at FAR no higher than the reproduced DX2026 baseline, without retroactively changing predictions.
Zero startup-fault episodes absorbed into an adaptive healthy baseline; each startup fault must be detected or explicitly abstained within 0.50 seconds, with no automatic baseline mutation.
Zero startup faults absorbed into the healthy reference over fault-at-zero, fault-during-warmup, sensor-bias and mode-shift falsification suites.
Zero live-baseline digest changes during shadow collection, quarantine and independent review.
Continue reference detection from sample zero while shadow adaptation runs, with p95 supported-event detection/abstention <=0.50 seconds at the matched false-alarm budget.
On source-matched boundary cases, zero forced singleton diagnoses where calibrated behavioral sets overlap; the true fault remains in the admissible set.
On the f_pic +8% type boundary, detect the anomaly while refusing unsupported known-cause isolation.

On independent no-fault episodes, the sequential process maintains empirical family-wise false-alarm probability at or below its configured bound within clustered uncertainty across arbitrary preregistered stopping rules.
Reduce median and p95 time-to-detection versus a matched fixed-window likelihood baseline at the same family-wise false-alarm budget.

prohibited_claims: cross-engine transfer from a single engine test bench
shipboard or fleet reliability from a laboratory engine dataset
actuator delivery confirmation from requested command signals
physical root cause from a residual threshold alone
superiority to a vendor product without a matched public protocol and baseline

inverse_identifiability_protocol.scope: Applicable only to a calibrated physical inverse/digital-twin comparator with explicit fault/degradation parameters and a validated parameter-to-signal map.
inverse_identifiability_protocol.local_sensitivity: Compute a dimensionless, uncertainty-whitened sensitivity Jacobian over the declared engine configuration and supported operating regime: J = Sigma^(-1/2) * d(h(theta))/d(theta) * D_theta, where D_theta scales parameters to preregistered dimensionless ranges.
inverse_identifiability_protocol.global_ambiguity: Explore declared parameter bounds with multi-start/profile or interval methods; accept hypotheses only when residual statistics are within an independently calibrated model-plus-measurement uncertainty region. Freeze the acceptance rule before confirmatory evaluation.

disposition_rules.UNIQUE_WITHIN_DECLARED_MODEL: Exactly one connected admissible hypothesis component and full, sufficiently conditioned local sensitivity rank under the preregistered tolerance.
disposition_rules.AMBIGUOUS_EQUIVALENCE_CLASS: Multiple admissible hypothesis components, rank deficiency, or condition number beyond the preregistered limit.
disposition_rules.NOT_EVALUATED: Missing model calibration, parameter map, uncertainty region, configuration identity or supported operating regime.

inverse_identifiability_protocol.caution: Full local Jacobian rank is not proof of global uniqueness. Never convert the optimizer's lowest-residual parameter vector into a unique physical cause without admissible-set and ambiguity checks.

operational_metric_definitions.inverse_solution_set_cardinality: Number of disconnected admissible fault/degradation parameter-hypothesis components under the frozen calibration acceptance rule.
operational_metric_definitions.false_unique_root_cause_rate: Cases where a system emits one unique physical cause although the reference admissible set contains multiple components or fails the preregistered identifiability condition.
operational_metric_definitions.parameter_identifiability_rank_or_condit: Numerical rank, singular spectrum and condition number of the dimensionless uncertainty-whitened response-sensitivity Jacobian, with tolerance and parameter scaling disclosed.

event_evaluation.onset_and_offset_source: authoritative sample annotations or independently recorded injection log; public approximate onset wording is insufficient

alarm_debounce.confirmation_time: timestamp of the third positive sample in the merged alarm episode

timing.normal_exposure: sum only adjacent observation intervals no longer than the configured maximum gap, minus overlap with fault-active intervals

event_evaluation.claim_ceiling: synthetic event-contract tests only until authoritative event labels, source data bytes and a frozen model run are audited

shift_matrix.core_rule: Condition shift, fault-semantic shift and combined shift are separate claims. Passing one axis never qualifies another.

active_evidence_selection.utility: minimum scenario-specific expected information gain / (1 + normalized cost + normalized delay + normalized risk)
active_evidence_selection.eligibility: Hard authority and safety eligibility first; require worst-case EIG above the frozen policy floor.
active_evidence_selection.epistemic_rule: Multiple scenario likelihoods are required for multi_scenario_assessed; independently reviewed likelihood calibration and worst-case EIG are both required for eligibility. Signer identity and calibration validity remain upstream trust duties.
active_evidence_selection.claim_ceiling: caller-supplied calibrated scenario tables and synthetic mathematical contracts only; no field acquisition or active intervention

risk_evidence.risk_score_ppm: caller-supplied policy score, not a calibrated probability
risk_evidence.qualification: upstream owner review, authority scope, signer, expiry and revocation checks must be evidenced before a qualified decision-support run

active_evidence_selection.multi_scenario_assessed: Reports whether multiple likelihood scenarios were assessed; this is not itself a calibration qualification.
active_evidence_selection.calibration_review_requirement: Every eligible candidate binds an independent calibration-review receipt; the independent review state is caller-supplied and must be authenticated upstream.

identity_contract.hypothesis_space: stable sorted hypothesis IDs only; remains unchanged as beliefs update
identity_contract.prior_distribution: separate digest over sorted IDs and exact probabilities; changes after every posterior update
identity_contract.candidate_model_binding: candidate likelihood tables bind the stable hypothesis-space digest, not a transient posterior
identity_contract.sequential_update: recompute portfolio with updated posterior and same stable hypothesis-space identity; append the external observation receipt to the ledger

chernoff.metric: minimum pairwise Chernoff information over positive-prior fault hypotheses, then minimum across all likelihood uncertainty scenarios
chernoff.assumption: asymptotic repeated conditionally independent observations; not a finite-sample diagnostic error guarantee

sequential_updates.rule: Multi-scenario likelihood candidates can be ranked robustly but cannot be used for sequential posterior updates until a joint hypothesis × persistent-scenario posterior ledger exists.

streaming_contract.claim_ceiling: append-only Rust source contract and synthetic tests only

literature_comparators.same_benchmark: Jung et al., A fault diagnosis benchmark of technical systems with incomplete data — six solutions, Control Engineering Practice 164 (2025), 106427. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.conengprac.2025.106427
literature_comparators.adjacent_marine_research: Lin et al., Fault diagnosis of marine diesel engine via control-aware domain-adversarial network (2026). The published abstract reports thermodynamic simulation results and explicitly notes absence of real-engine validation. https://doi.org/10.1177/01423312261487500
literature_comparators.deployment_assessment: The 2026 industrial CPS/ICS deployability survey finds that accuracy is much more commonly assessed than other deployment criteria; use a wider readiness matrix rather than accuracy-only comparisons. https://doi.org/10.1007/s10207-026-01330-1
literature_comparators.standards_alignment: ISO 13379-1:2025 diagnostic guidance is contextual alignment, not certification. https://www.iso.org/standard/88027.html

deployability_matrix.rule: Each dimension is separately evidenced and reviewed. No dimension can be inferred from another and no weighted score can override a missing dimension.

behavioral_set_diagnosis.output_rule: Return the complete set of hypotheses whose calibrated multivariate behavioral envelopes intersect the observed measurement-uncertainty box within a supported regime.
behavioral_set_diagnosis.unknown_rule: Zero admissible hypotheses is unknown_or_out_of_support; missing/stale/conflicted inputs and unsupported regimes are not_evaluable.
behavioral_set_diagnosis.uniqueness_rule: A singleton is unique only within the frozen declared catalogue; global unique physical cause is prohibited.
behavioral_set_diagnosis.claim_ceiling: source contract and synthetic fixtures only

startup_adaptation_guard.failure_policy: quarantine candidate; do not alter live reference
startup_adaptation_guard.claim_ceiling: source contract and synthetic fixtures only

dx2026_boundary_falsification.principle: Diagnosis ambiguity and out-of-support are valid outputs; the classifier must not manufacture a known physical cause merely because detection fired.
